    Exact mesh relations for the lifted arrows (Proposition 10.1(3)) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "The category E₄ has a quadratic scalar mesh presentation with unit coefficients reducing to the all-one presentation."

    We use only the part needed later: the lifted arrows satisfy the mesh relations exactly for unit coefficients ũ reducing to c (WData.mesh_exact). The mesh error of the lifted arrows with the lifted coefficients reduces to zero, so it is twice an A⁽²⁾-map of degree two (exists_halfMap); such a map is a combination of the length-two paths at the row, and subtracting twice its coefficients corrects the mesh coefficients.
